scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am a messenger from the Royal court, sent to find a reliable adventurer. This is all about the very important issues of our nation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我是来自王宫的信使，奉命寻找一位可靠的冒险者。
此事关乎我国极其重要的议题。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
It might have brought national disorder, but people are all wary about the rebirth of the devil. We are in the perfect times to process this issue without making any additional fuss.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
虽然这可能引发国家动荡，但人们对恶魔的复活都心存警惕。
现在是处理此事的最佳时机，可以避免引起额外的骚乱。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Oh, I don't want you to panic too much... Hmm... what I want to say is, Tristan the third, the ruler of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
哦，我不想让你太惊慌... 嗯... 我想说的是，卢恩·米德加兹的统治者，特里斯坦三世...

scripts.text: Passed away?
scripts.translation: 去世了？

scripts.text: Came for a celebration again?
scripts.translation: 又来庆祝了？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
You already know about that...
Then, I don't need to give
you any further explanation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你竟然已经知道了...
那么，我就不必再做进一步的解释了。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The King's position cannot
be empty for too long.
Now, the debate over selecting our next King is actively in progress. Please give us a hand with this, for the tomorrow of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
王位不能长期空缺。
目前，关于下一任国王的选拔辩论正在进行中。
请为我们出一份力，为了卢恩·米德加兹的明天。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
...

[Messenger]
What are you thinking?
Do you really think a celebration is momentous for a nation right now?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你在想什么？
你真的认为在国家当前局势下，庆祝是一件大事吗？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Yeah...
It's quite natural for you to expect nothing. I still don't know how to express this to you. Don't be too perplexed.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
是啊...
你一无所知也很正常。我还不知道该怎么跟你说才好。别太困惑。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Tristan the 3rd, the ruler of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
卢恩·米德加兹的统治者，特里斯坦三世...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
...
has passed away.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
...
已经去世了。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
To prevent the people's disorder, it won't yet be announced. The Court is focused on selecting the next king right now. They are very busy considering it.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
为了防止民众动荡，此事尚未公布。宫廷正专注于选拔下一任国王。他们正忙于考虑此事。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
You can learn more details in court. My mission is only to deliver this message to a reliable and brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你可以在宫廷了解更多详情。我的任务只是将这条消息传达给一位可靠且勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Please...Please...
Lend a hand for the future
of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
请...请...
为了卢恩·米德加兹王国的未来，伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
It might have brought national disorder, but people are all wary about the rebirth of the devil. We are in the perfect times to process this issue without making any additional fuss.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
虽然这可能引发国家动荡，但人们对恶魔的复活都心存警惕。
现在是处理此事的最佳时机，可以避免引起额外的骚乱。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The King hasn't appeared
in public for some time.
Many are curious about the situation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
国王已经有一段时间没有公开露面了。
许多人都对情况感到好奇。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I hate my duty to deliver
this sorrowful reality to others.
I think you already have a clue from my words...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我讨厌我的职责，将这一悲伤的现实传达给他人。
我想从我的话中，你已经有所察觉了...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
King Tristan...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
特里斯坦国王...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
King Tristan...
...passed away...
...after a long time of suffering acutely from illness.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
特里斯坦国王...
...去世了...
...在长期遭受重病折磨之后。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The Royal Court is now in the process of selecting the next king. My mission is to find a devoted adventurer and send them to court.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
王宫目前正在选拔下一任国王。我的任务是寻找一位忠诚的冒险者，并送他们前往宫廷。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
They will let you know what
you have to do in court.
I hope you will help bring
peace to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
他们会告诉你需要在宫廷做什么。
希望你能帮助卢恩·米德加兹恢复和平。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am a messenger of Rune-Midgarts.
Is there something special
in this country?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我是卢恩·米德加兹的信使。
这个国家有什么特别的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Haven't you seen something mysterious? Or heard some gossip?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你没看到什么神秘的事情吗？或者听到什么传闻？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I want you to go to the Prontera Royal Court to help in the next King's selection.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我要你去普隆德拉王宫，协助下一任国王的选拔。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I will stay here to find other adventurers. May your heart bring great glory to Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我会留在这里寻找其他冒险者。愿你的心灵为卢恩·米德加兹带来荣耀！

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am on a mission now. I think you may be looking for a different location. Ask others.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我现在正在执行任务。我想你可能在找别的地方。问问其他人吧。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Judge!
How goes it? I don't think it is easy to meet seven candidates and appraise them.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
评估员！
进展如何？我觉得会见并评估七位候选人并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ha. Are you done?
You are a fast worker, getting the job done!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
哈。结束了吗？
你工作真快，效率很高！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Let me have the scoop on the candidates~
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
让我听听关于候选人的消息~

scripts.text:
-I talked about my impression
of the candidates for prince,
to the Inspector, right away.
I'm sure, I only give clear
and concise facts to him.-
scripts.translation:
-我立刻向检查员讲述了我对王子候选人的印象。
我相信，我只向他提供了清晰且简洁的事实。-

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hmm... is that so? What you've said has helped me a lot. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
嗯...是吗？你说的话对我帮助很大。谢谢你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
By the way, I happened
to hear a rumor about
Prince Eigen Ahrum of the Walter family. Could you appraise all the candidates, one more time? I need this done urgently.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
顺便说一下，我偶然听到了关于沃尔特家族的艾根·阿鲁姆王子的传闻。你能再评估一次所有候选人吗？我需要尽快完成这件事。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now the whole picture may change... Others must probably be the same. But I worry about Eigen Ahrum because I can't neglect any rumors about any candidate.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
现在整体情况可能会改变...其他人可能也是如此。但我担心艾根·阿鲁姆，因为我不能忽视任何关于任何候选人的传闻。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Okay, so... please go in there one more time.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
好的，那么...请再进去一次。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What's wrong with you?
This is not an open area!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你怎么了？
这里不是公开区域！

scripts.text: Alright, Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的，好的

scripts.text: The Messenger directed me here.
scripts.translation: 信使指引我来的

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
If you know it, why are you here? Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果你知道的话，为什么还在这里？快离开这里！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I don't think
that he is an experienced appraiser...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我觉得他不是一个有经验的评估员...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
......

[Inspector]
The Messenger checked only for your physical aptitude, and simply sent a warrior to Court. That's what his duty is all about.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
信使只检查了你的身体条件，就把战士送到了宫廷。这就是他的职责所在。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Checking your qualification is a matter that concerns me.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
审查你的资格是我的职责。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You are an experienced traveler. You have enough strength, but... The Court doesn't choose a person based only on his or her great strength and battle experience.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你是一位经验丰富的旅行者。你拥有足够的力量，但是...宫廷选拔人才，不仅仅看力量和战斗经验。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
To check someone's quality
you have to have enough
personality about you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
要考察别人的素质，你自己必须具备足够的品格。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
In that sense, I want to do a simple experiment.
Let's test you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
从这个意义上说，我想做一个简单的实验。
让我们来测试一下你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
This won't be complicated. You are just needed to give a quick answer, frankly please, after each given situation.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
这不会很复杂。你只需要在每种情况下，快速、坦率地给出回答。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
kay, let's start. Get ready. Listen carefully and answer.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
好，我们开始。做好准备。仔细听题并回答。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What do you think is the
most important thing to consider
as a leader of a hunt party?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你认为作为狩猎队伍的首领，最重要的考量是什么？

scripts.text: Strength and characteristics of the monster.
scripts.translation: 魔物的力量和特性

scripts.text: Efficiency of the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩猎的效率

scripts.text: What we can get from the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩猎能获得的收益

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What if we lose a party member
during battle?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果在战斗中失去了队伍成员怎么办？

scripts.text: Keep fighting until we can do it.
scripts.translation: 坚持战斗直到成功

scripts.text: Find a new place and try differently.
scripts.translation: 换个地方，尝试不同的策略

scripts.text: Stop hunting and replenish.
scripts.translation: 停止狩猎，进行补给

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What you get as a result of the hunt...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
狩猎结束后获得的战利品...

scripts.text: Share it as agreed prior.
scripts.translation: 按事先约定分配

scripts.text: I don't want to care for sharing.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎怎么分配

scripts.text: Give it to the member that needs it.
scripts.translation: 分给需要的成员

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of job class member
has to be cured while the enemy still lives?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
哪种职业的成员必须在敌人存活时进行治疗？

scripts.text: Priest, healer class.
scripts.translation: 牧师，治疗职业

scripts.text: Hunter, damage dealer.
scripts.translation: 猎人，输出职业

scripts.text: Lord Knight, tanker.
scripts.translation: 骑士领主，坦克职业

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Whom do you want to befriend the most?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你最想和谁成为朋友？

scripts.text: A strong person.
scripts.translation: 强大的人

scripts.text: An experienced person.
scripts.translation: 经验丰富的人

scripts.text: A kind person.
scripts.translation: 善良的人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What was your ability that helped
you the most during your training?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
在训练中，哪项能力对你帮助最大？

scripts.text: Relationships with people.
scripts.translation: 人际关系

scripts.text: Plenty of information gathering.
scripts.translation: 广泛的信息收集

scripts.text: Discernment and driving force.
scripts.translation: 判断力与执行力

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How do you give encouragement to others, usually?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你通常如何鼓励他人？

scripts.text: Refer to a past failure.
scripts.translation: 提及过去的失败

scripts.text: Hesitating is the worst thing.
scripts.translation: 犹豫是最糟糕的

scripts.text: You are not alone.
scripts.translation: 你不是一个人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What is an ultimate virtue
in your life?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你人生中的终极美德是什么？

scripts.text: Growth of oneself.
scripts.translation: 自我成长

scripts.text: World peace.
scripts.translation: 世界和平

scripts.text: The pursuit of truth.
scripts.translation: 追求真理

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What would you want to keep
the most if you were on a 
deserted island?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果你被困在荒岛上，你最想保留什么？

scripts.text: Map
scripts.translation: 地图

scripts.text: Flint
scripts.translation: 燧石

scripts.text: Weapon
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of story do you like the most?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你最喜欢哪种类型的故事？

scripts.text: Love story.
scripts.translation: 爱情故事

scripts.text: Heroic epic.
scripts.translation: 英雄史诗

scripts.text: Religious tale.
scripts.translation: 宗教传说

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've come to engage the
new monster in a new area.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你来到了新区域，准备挑战新的魔物。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text: Attack first.
scripts.translation: 先发制人

scripts.text: Observe from a distance.
scripts.translation: 远距离观察

scripts.text: Flee away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What has to be done first when
ruling the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
统治卢恩·米德加兹王国时，首先要做什么？

scripts.text: Dominate countries by reinforcing militia.
scripts.translation: 加强军备，征服各国

scripts.text: Advancement of economy and technology.
scripts.translation: 发展经济与科技

scripts.text: Keep public security firm.
scripts.translation: 维护社会治安

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Your humanity test is done.
You have been living...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你的人性测试结束了。
你一直过着...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong conviction,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
信念坚定、判断合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
勇敢无畏，却又懂得节制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a decisive mind.
You could overcome hardships with it.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
果断决绝的生活。
凭借它，你能够克服苦难。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with firmness,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
意志坚定、判断合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and a harmonic sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
理性判断与和谐感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a calm and prudent decision.
I think you could also have had many good experiences.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
冷静而审慎的生活。
我想，你也一定有过许多美好的经历。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
勇敢无畏，却又懂得节制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and peaceful sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
理性判断与宁静感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
...Erm, actually...
You didn't distort to either way...
and stability and harmony were
an important virtue in your life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
...嗯，其实...
你并没有偏向任何一方...
稳定与和谐是你生活中重要的美德。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think you are
qualified enough to evaluate others. I apologize for my rude behavior to you in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我认为你完全有资格去评价他人。
我为一开始对你的无礼行为表示歉意。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, I ask you to do us a favor. You have become a regular adventurer appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
所以，我请你帮我们一个忙。
你已成为一名正式的冒险者评估员。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ah, you've spent a long time with me. You must be very tired. Before starting work, if you need some preparation, take off now and come back to me later. I will be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
啊，你和我在一起已经很久了。
你一定很累了。
在开始工作之前，如果需要做准备，现在可以先离开，稍后再回来找我。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I don't think you are
an experienced adventurer...
And this is an important issue for the nation. I can't give this job to anyone like you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我觉得你并不像是一位经验丰富的冒险者...
而且这对国家来说是一件大事。
我不能把这个任务交给像你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
But, if you prove yourself a strong adventurer, then I will let you pass the first qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
但是，如果你能证明自己是一名强大的冒险者，那么我会让你通过第一道资格测试。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Have you heard of Glastheim? In that area, there are monsters named Knights of Abyss.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你听说过格拉斯特海姆吗？
在那个地区，有一种名为深渊骑士的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
After beating the knights of abyss
bring 2 ^ff0000Reins^000000.
If you can do this mission,
I will respect your strength.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
击败深渊骑士后，带回2个^ff0000缰绳^000000。
如果你能完成这个任务，我会尊重你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Let's continue our talk
after getting the 2 Reins.
Ciao...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
拿到2个缰绳后，我们再继续谈话。
再见...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ahh, you came to meet me before huh? I guess you've already been to Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
啊，你之前就来找我了？
看来你已经去过格拉斯特海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Do you have the 2 reins I mentioned?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你有我提到的那2个缰绳吗？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ooh!
Frankly, I didn't expect you to bring them. You are great.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
哦！
说实话，我没想到你能把它们带回来。
你很棒。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Alright, good. You proved your strength for yourself. Now you passed one exam. All but one.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
很好。你证明了自己的实力。
现在你通过了一项考试。
只剩最后一项了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
The judge to appraise princes should build up his character too. Strength cannot cover everything. Personality should come along with it
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
评估王子的评判者也应该具备高尚的品格。
实力不能涵盖一切，性格也必须与之相符。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
In a sense, the next examination is to test your character. It is just a series of simple questions, but relax first, and be prepared mentally... then come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
从某种意义上说，下一项考试是测试你的品格。
这只是一系列简单的问题，但请先放松一下，做好心理准备...
然后再来找我谈话。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've never even taken such a dangerous mission before! How dare you think you could come to this place? I don't think you can take the job of evaluating princes.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你甚至从未执行过如此危险的任务！
你怎么敢想你能来这个地方？
我认为你不能胜任评估王子的职位。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now, you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
现在，你可以稍后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now are you ready?
This test is not that hard though...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你准备好了吗？
虽然这项测试不算太难...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
This is done to know your attitude and behavior in certain situations. Listen carefully to my questions, and answer frankly in regards to the episodes of your trip.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
这是为了了解你在特定情况下的态度和行为。
请仔细听我的问题，并如实回答关于你旅途经历的问题。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now, let me begin.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
那么，我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What do you think is the
most important thing to consider
as a leader of a hunt party?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你认为作为狩猎队伍的首领，最重要的考量是什么？

scripts.text: Strength and characteristics of the monster.
scripts.translation: 魔物的力量和特性

scripts.text: Efficiency of the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩猎的效率

scripts.text: What we can get from the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩猎能获得的收益

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What if we lose a party member
during battle?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果在战斗中失去了队伍成员怎么办？

scripts.text: Keep fighting until we can do it.
scripts.translation: 坚持战斗直到成功

scripts.text: Find a new place and try differently.
scripts.translation: 换个地方，尝试不同的策略

scripts.text: Stop hunting and replenish.
scripts.translation: 停止狩猎，进行补给

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What you get as a result of the hunt...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
狩猎结束后获得的战利品...

scripts.text: Share it as agreed prior.
scripts.translation: 按事先约定分配

scripts.text: I don't want to care for sharing.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎怎么分配

scripts.text: Give it to the member that needs it.
scripts.translation: 分给需要的成员

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of job class member
has to be cured while the enemy still lives?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
哪种职业的成员必须在敌人存活时进行治疗？

scripts.text: Priest, healer class.
scripts.translation: 牧师，治疗职业

scripts.text: Hunter, damage dealer.
scripts.translation: 猎人，输出职业

scripts.text: Lord Knight, tanker.
scripts.translation: 骑士领主，坦克职业

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Whom do you want to befriend the most?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你最想和谁成为朋友？

scripts.text: A strong person.
scripts.translation: 强大的人

scripts.text: An experienced person.
scripts.translation: 经验丰富的人

scripts.text: A kind person.
scripts.translation: 善良的人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What was your ability that helped
you the most during your training?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
在训练中，哪项能力对你帮助最大？

scripts.text: Relationships with people.
scripts.translation: 人际关系

scripts.text: Plenty of information gathering.
scripts.translation: 广泛的信息收集

scripts.text: Discernment and driving force.
scripts.translation: 判断力与执行力

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How do you give encouragement to others, usually?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你通常如何鼓励他人？

scripts.text: Refer to a past failure.
scripts.translation: 提及过去的失败

scripts.text: Hesitating is the worst thing.
scripts.translation: 犹豫是最糟糕的

scripts.text: You are not alone.
scripts.translation: 你不是一个人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What is an ultimate virtue
in your life?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你人生中的终极美德是什么？

scripts.text: Growth of oneself.
scripts.translation: 自我成长

scripts.text: World peace.
scripts.translation: 世界和平

scripts.text: The pursuit of truth.
scripts.translation: 追求真理

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What would you want to keep
the most if you were on a 
deserted island?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果你被困在荒岛上，你最想保留什么？

scripts.text: Map
scripts.translation: 地图

scripts.text: Flint
scripts.translation: 燧石

scripts.text: Weapon
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of story do you like the most?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你最喜欢哪种类型的故事？

scripts.text: Love story.
scripts.translation: 爱情故事

scripts.text: Heroic epic.
scripts.translation: 英雄史诗

scripts.text: Religious tale.
scripts.translation: 宗教传说

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've come to engage the
new monster in a new area.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你来到了新区域，准备挑战新的魔物。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text: Attack first.
scripts.translation: 先发制人

scripts.text: Observe from a distance.
scripts.translation: 远距离观察

scripts.text: Flee away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What has to be done first when
ruling the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
统治卢恩·米德加兹王国时，首先要做什么？

scripts.text: Dominate countries by reinforcing militia.
scripts.translation: 加强军备，征服各国

scripts.text: Advancement of economy and technology.
scripts.translation: 发展经济与科技

scripts.text: Keep public security firm.
scripts.translation: 维护社会治安

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Your humanity test is done.
You have been living...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你的人性测试结束了。
你一直过着...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong conviction,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
信念坚定、判断合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
勇敢无畏，却又懂得节制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a decisive mind.
You could overcome hardships with it.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
果断决绝的生活。
凭借它，你能够克服苦难。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with firmness,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
意志坚定、判断合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and a harmonic sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
理性判断与和谐感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a calm and prudent decision.
I think you could also have had many good experiences.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
冷静而审慎的生活。
我想，你也一定有过许多美好的经历。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
勇敢无畏，却又懂得节制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and peaceful sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
理性判断与宁静感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
...Erm, actually...
You didn't distort to either way...
and stability and harmony were
an important virtue in your life.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
...嗯，其实...
你并没有偏向任何一方...
稳定与和谐是你生活中重要的美德。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think you are
qualified enough to evaluate others. I apologize for my rude behavior to you in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我认为你完全有资格去评价他人。
我为一开始对你的无礼行为表示歉意。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, I ask you to do us a favor. You have become a regular adventurer appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
所以，我请你帮我们一个忙。
你已成为一名正式的冒险者评估员。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ah, you've spent a long time with me. You must be very tired. Before starting work, if you need some preparation, take off now and come back to me later. I will be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
啊，你和我在一起已经很久了。
你一定很累了。
在开始工作之前，如果需要做准备，现在可以先离开，稍后再回来找我。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Welcome...
I will give you some
instructions on what to do,
and what one has to be careful with, when dealing with princes. Pay attention to me.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
欢迎...
我将向你说明在与王子打交道时该做什么，以及需要注意什么。
请仔细听我说。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I will answer your questions first.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我先回答你的问题。

scripts.text: What should I do, exactly?
scripts.translation: 我具体该做什么？

scripts.text: The King died because of his illness?
scripts.translation: 国王是因为生病去世的吗？

scripts.text: Is my mission confidential??
scripts.translation: 我的任务是保密的吗？

scripts.text: I have no more questions.
scripts.translation: 我没有其他问题了

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
We have seven candidates from seven families. One per each family. The candidates are all in the same place, where I will introduce them to you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我们有来自七个家族的七名候选人。
每个家族各出一人。
候选人都在同一个地方，我会在那里向你介绍他们。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You have to meet the candidates one by one, and ask some questions about their quality; or observe their actions, then come back to me and explain all that you observed in detail.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你需要逐一会见候选人，询问关于他们品质的问题；或者观察他们的行为，然后回来向我详细汇报你观察到的一切。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
The original rule is that the quality of princes has to be appraised by royal families for a long time, and one has to be elected by internal ordinance.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
原本的规则是，王子的品质必须由王室家族经过长时间的评估，并通过内部法令进行选举。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Because of the resurrection of the devil Satan Morocc, people are too uneasy to follow regular announcements, and the atmosphere of the kingdom is not stable.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
由于魔王梦罗克的复活，人们过于不安，无法遵循常规的公告，王国的局势也不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Each kingdom is busy preventing the interference of Satan Morocc too.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
各个王国都忙于防范魔王梦罗克的干涉。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So this time, the Court decided to change its ways, giving the opportunity to appraise the candidates to famous and devoted adventurers like yourself. That's why you are here.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
因此，这次宫廷决定改变方式，将评估候选人的机会交给像你这样著名且忠诚的冒险者。
这就是你在这里的原因。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How absurd that you ask that!! I already told you clearly that King Tristan died of illness, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你怎么会问这种荒谬的问题！！
我已经明确告诉过你，国王特里斯坦是因病去世的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Don't you have anything else to be curious about?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你难道没有其他好奇的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Sure...
It's natural to announce the death of the King. But the atmosphere of the nation is not ripe for it. This is our only alternative for now.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
当然...
宣布国王的死讯是自然的。
但国家的氛围尚未成熟到可以接受这一点。
这是我们目前唯一的替代方案。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Princes cannot go outside on their own will. People cannot go to the place where the princes are.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
王子不能擅自外出。
人们也不能去王子所在的地方。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think this is enough
instruction for this.
Now I will let you know
where you can meet the princes.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我想这些说明已经足够了。
现在我将告诉你在哪里可以会见王子。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
When you get to the medic officer's room, a soldier will be standing on a strange spot. You can find that there isn't a door there.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
当你到达医务兵的房间时，会有一名士兵站在一个奇怪的位置。你会发现那里并没有门。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Behind the soldier, you can find a secret door. If you talk to the soldier, the soldier will allow you to get in.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
在士兵身后，你可以找到一扇暗门。如果你和士兵交谈，他会允许你进入。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
As I have expressed, this is a very important issue for the Rune-Midgarts kingdom. Although I've stressed this point repeateadly, I cannot stress it enough.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
正如我所强调的，这对卢恩·米德加兹王国来说是一件非常重要的事情。虽然我反复强调过这一点，但我还是觉得强调得不够。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Please behave accordingly.
Thanks for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
请照此行事。
感谢你的努力。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You got instructions as to what you should do, didn't you? This issue is not that worthless that you can take it with ease! Pay attention to this!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你已经收到了关于该做什么的指示，对吧？这件事并不像你想象的那么微不足道，不能掉以轻心！请认真对待！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
If you are not motivated to do it, I will find another adventurer. You can go back to your business, if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
如果你没有动力去做这件事，我会另找一位冒险者。如果你愿意的话，可以回去做你的事了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How is it going?
Grading someone is not a piece of cake. It's real hard work indeed. You do the hard work for our country.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
进展如何？
评估某人并不是一件轻松的事。这确实是辛苦的工作。你为我们的国家付出了艰辛的努力。

scripts.text: -I tell him about the Ahrum and Ernst accident.-
scripts.translation: -我告诉他关于阿鲁姆和恩斯特事故的事。-

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What!? I can't believe it!
Wha-, that's so...
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
什么！？我简直不敢相信！
什...这太...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
By Ernst's hand...?
Yes...?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
是恩斯特干的...？
是的...？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've fulfilled the job as
adventurer appraiser fully.
I really appreciate your assistance thus far. Due to your help, the future of the kingdom is indebted to you.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你完全履行了冒险者评估员的职责。
我非常感激你迄今为止的帮助。多亏了你的协助，王国的未来才得以保全。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He doesn't seem to be suprised too much.. Could there be a reason? Now I am suspicious...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他似乎并没有太惊讶...难道有什么原因吗？我现在开始怀疑了...）

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hey, the things you experienced here cannot be disclosed to others. You understand that this situation is fully confidential.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
嘿，你在这里经历的事情不能透露给其他人。你要明白，此事是绝对机密。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, keep up the good work.
For the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
所以，继续好好干吧。
为了卢恩·米德加兹王国！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Then, let me hit the road..
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
那么，我要出发了...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
All for the glory
of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
为了卢恩·米德加兹的荣耀！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hello, appraiser.
I hope you are able to finish your mission perfectly. Have you met with all the princes, like I told you to?
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你好，评估员。
我希望你能完美地完成你的任务。按照我告诉你的那样，你见过所有的王子了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Very well.
I like hearing about the princes.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
很好。
我喜欢听关于王子们的消息。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Are you sure?
Please check on all the princes.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
你确定吗？
请确认你已经见过所有的王子。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Don't be coy. I'm sure you have done it already.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
别谦虚了。我相信你已经做过了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
My investigations on all the princes are done.
scripts.translation:
[检查员]
我对所有王子的调查已经结束了。

scripts.text:
-Obssessed with making
lock and key.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎对制作锁和钥匙非常着迷。-

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...What bad luck I have!
But he insists me to be corrupted, knowing how it would be...
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
...我的运气真差！
但他坚持认为我已经被腐蚀了，尽管他知道那会是什么样子...

scripts.text:
[Erich]
These days, I have bad luck... Only harrassments happen to me...
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
最近，我的运气很差...只有麻烦事发生在我身上...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Who are you?
I don't think you are eligible
to be entering this room?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是谁？
你应该没有资格进入这个房间吧？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
I order you out of
my sight.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我命令你从我的视线中消失。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Who are you?
Someone must have been instructed about the presence of the hidden entrance. Unless... Are you the adventurer appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是谁？
一定有人被指示过关于隐藏入口的存在。除非...你是冒险者评估员？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Are you?... Do me a favor then. I am a legitimate son from the Nerius family. My name is Erich. You can call me Prince Erich.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是吗？...那就帮我个忙。我是内里乌斯家族的嫡子。我的名字是埃里希。你可以叫我埃里希王子。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
My full name is...
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我的全名是...

scripts.text:
[Erich]
That's enough.
You can ask information about me to my servant. I will take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
够了。
你可以向我的仆人询问关于我的信息。我要休息了。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
......My conscience!
It doesn't work well...
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
......我的良心！
它不太管用了...

scripts.text: -He seems to be so obssessed to care about anything else.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎太过沉迷，对其他任何事都漠不关心。-

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ahh... mmm... I...
I... am so, sorry!
I... think I made a big mistake with the appraiser!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
啊...嗯...我...
我...非常抱歉！
我...我想我在评估员的事情上犯了一个大错误！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
My prince didn't do anything wrong but, anyways, I apologize for anything to you!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
我的王子并没有做错什么，但无论如何，我向您道歉！

scripts.text:
Incessantly...-
-He has jitters whenever I react to him. His actions give me a feeling of pity.-
scripts.translation:
不停地...-
-每当我对他做出反应时，他都会紧张不安。他的行为让我感到怜悯。-

scripts.text:
[Hans]
How are you doing, sir?
My name is Hans, servant of Prince Erich.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
您好，先生。
我叫汉斯，是埃里希王子的仆人。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
我能为您做什么？

scripts.text: Prince Erich told me to meet you.
scripts.translation: 埃里希王子让我来见你

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Did Prince Erich...?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
是埃里希王子...？

scripts.text: I want to listen to a story of him.
scripts.translation: 我想听听关于他的事

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ahh, I see.
Frankly, Prince Erich is not interested in regime that much.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
啊，我明白了。
说实话，埃里希王子对政治并不太感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
He writes in his journal daily. On his wedding day, he jotted down: 'Like, nothing special happened today'. He doesn't care about current events or human relationships.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
他每天都会写日记。在他的婚礼那天，他写道：“今天没什么特别的事发生”。他不在乎时事，也不在乎人际关系。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
What he likes is making locks.
He is eccentric, isn't he?
He is a kind of jester.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
他喜欢制作锁。
他真古怪，不是吗？
他就像个小丑。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
He doesn't like classy costumes either. He didn't even bring a dress suit here. And as soon as he got here, he was immersed in making a lock and key, like that.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
他也不喜欢华丽的服装。他甚至没带礼服来这里。而且他一到这儿，就沉浸在做锁和钥匙里了，就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
I don't think I have the proper expression for you... I don't think I have something special to say about him to you. You can just appraise him as you see him...
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
我想我找不到合适的词来形容他...我觉得没有什么特别的话要对您说。您可以按您看到的样子去评价他...

scripts.text:
[Hans]
That's all I can say about this.
Huh...~
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
关于他，我只能说这么多。
嗯...~

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ah, Prince!
You can cut your finger!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
啊，王子！
你会切到手指的！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
...Hmm he cannot even hear...
Oooooh...
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
...嗯，他连听都听不见...
噢噢噢...

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Did you meet the other princes?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
你见过其他王子吗？

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Although you may ask something, you will not hear anything special from him now.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
虽然你可以问点什么，但现在你从他那里听不到什么特别的话。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Hello?
Are you the new adventurer appraiser??
scripts.translation:
[汉斯]
你好？
你是新的冒险者评估员吗？？

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...It is not beautiful.
It discomforts me...
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
...这并不美。
这让我感到不适...

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
 feel very much displeased. Hey, what are you looking at? Get out!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
我非常不高兴。嘿，你在看什么？滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My beautiful body isn't in perfect condition right now. I don't want to show it to anyone today.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
我美丽的身体现在状态不佳。我今天不想让任何人看到。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...What? What did you...
just say to me?... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
...什么？你刚才...
对我说了什么？...嗯？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Huuuuuuu
The position is not suitable for you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
呼————
这个位置不适合你。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Get away from me, as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
尽快离我远点。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
La~ lalalala~ lalala~
Are you the person, supposed to look me over and appraise my quality?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦啦~
你就是那个负责审视我、评估我品质的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
The daffodil you are gazing at is called Urugen. It bloomed at Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你凝视的那朵水仙花名叫乌鲁根。它是在维格纳家族盛开的。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
I usually don't let anyone hear my beautiful voice, but this time, I will give a special service for you.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
我通常不让人听到我美妙的声音，但这次，我要为你特别服务一次。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
listen...
Let me answer with my
unforgettable, clear and beautiful voice.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
听好了...
让我用那令人难忘、清澈而美丽的声音来回答你。

scripts.text: I want to know your background.
scripts.translation: 我想了解你的身世

scripts.text: Let me know your view of the nation.
scripts.translation: 告诉我你对国家的看法

scripts.text: What are your hobbies or tastes?
scripts.translation: 你的爱好或品味是什么？

scripts.text: Let me leave.
scripts.translation: 让我离开

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My dashing face from
childhood brought envy and jealousy from men, and endless proposals from women. I felt sick with it, so I came to be away from people.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
我英俊的面容从小就招致了男人的嫉妒，以及女人无尽的求婚。这让我感到恶心，所以我选择远离人群。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My beautiful person
shouldn't bear stuff like that sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
像我这样美丽的人，有时不该承受这些。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
I became timid, gradually, in phases. I feel awe from men and women both, regardless of sexuality.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
我逐渐变得胆小起来。无论男女，人们都对我心怀敬畏，与性别无关。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
People should do what they are supposed to do. That's the source of drive for a nation. For me, my existence will be enough, for the nation.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
人们应该做他们该做的事。这是一个国家的动力源泉。对我来说，我的存在就足以支撑这个国家了。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
The presence of such a gorgeous king like me will be the light for people and the hope and reason for their lives.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
像我这样华丽的国王的存在，将是人们的光，是他们生活的希望和理由。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
For sure, taking care of my body. Humans should pursue beauty. It's quite natural, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
当然，还有照顾我的身体。人类应该追求美。这不是很自然吗？

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
In every case, there is an exception, like you in this court. Can you stand away from me a bit more? Because of your odor, I can hardly breathe.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
凡事皆有例外，比如你在这个宫廷里。你能离我远一点吗？因为你的气味，我几乎无法呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Your spirit must be so strong. Looking over my beauty so long a time, you haven't lost your spirit yet.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
你的精神一定很坚强。凝视我的美丽这么久，你还没有失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Such an idiot. I should have killed him earlier. Now I feel relieved.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
真是个白痴。我早该杀了他。现在我感到如释重负。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Damn... Damn it!
Novice of Walter!!
How can I deal with this stress? Damn! Hell!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
该死...该死！
沃尔特家的毛头小子！！
我该怎么发泄这股火气？该死！见鬼！

scripts.text:
-He is so blushed,
evidently shown on his face.-
scripts.translation: -他满脸通红，怒气全写在脸上。-

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You are not supposed to be here!
Can't you keep away from me!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你不该在这里！
你能不能离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Are you the new appraiser? I am fed up with the many visitors! Let's take up the main subject!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你就是新来的评估员？我受够了那些访客！我们直接谈正事吧！

scripts.text: -What subject should I start with?-
scripts.translation: -我该从哪个话题开始呢？-

scripts.text: Your background...
scripts.translation: 你的背景...

scripts.text: Your ambition...
scripts.translation: 你的抱负...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你对国家的看法...

scripts.text: I want to meet others first.
scripts.translation: 我想先认识一下其他人

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't know how others react but, I feel very uptight with your question. I shouldn't, but, I don't have a different view!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我不知道别人怎么想，但你的问题让我非常紧张。我不该这样，但我没有其他看法！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am the prince; if you grumble, you become prince! I feel tiresome with this kind of questioning.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我才是王子；你要是不满，你来当王子啊！这种问题让我烦透了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
............
Yes, I understand. Go ahead...

[Helmut]
I am Helmut from Roewenburg.
What I like is smelling blood in the battlefield, and I enjoy festivals too.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我是来自罗文堡的赫尔穆特。
我喜欢在战场上嗅到血腥味，也喜欢节日庆典。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
What I hate is sticking to formality, and talking much. As for ambition? What am I going to do when I become... king...?? I am asked this question many times.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我讨厌拘泥于形式，也讨厌喋喋不休。至于抱负？等我成为...国王...之后要做什么？？这个问题我被问过很多次了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
When I become king, I will reinforce our troops and conquer continent after unification of continent; I will eradicate all the monsters that are harmful to my people!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
等我成为国王，我会加强军队，在大陆统一后征服其他大陆；我将消灭所有危害我子民的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
~Kuffkuff~! I have a sore throat! It's been a while since I've used my throat. ~Kuffkuff~!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
~咳咳~！我喉咙痛！好久没这么说话了。~咳咳~！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hey Calbern!
Bring beer! Beer!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
嘿，卡尔贝恩！
拿啤酒来！啤酒！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Why are you still standing there? I have nothing else to say to you! Stand back!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你还站在那儿干什么？我没什么好说的了！退后！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, Prince,
I will be back later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，王子，我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Alright, up to you.
Hey! Hey Calbern!
Move your ass here with beer!
Do you want to be beaten down?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
好吧，随你。
嘿！嘿，卡尔贝恩！
带着啤酒滚过来！
你想挨打吗？

scripts.text:
[Calbern]
How are you doing, sir?
I am the servant of Prince Helmut...
Calbern.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
您好，大人。
我是赫尔穆特王子的仆人...
卡尔贝恩。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hey Calbern!
Bring beer! Beer!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
嘿，卡尔贝恩！
拿啤酒来！啤酒！

scripts.text:
[Calbern]
Oops, I am so sorry.
I got business...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
哎呀，非常抱歉。
我有事要忙...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Whatever the condition is, he is just a loser in the match of life.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
无论情况如何，他只是在人生的比赛中输了而已。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
He gave up without any challenge. That's not what the man has to do. He is not as good as me. But okay. I am disappointed in him. Eigen Ahrum.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
他连挑战都没发起就放弃了。这不是一个男人该有的样子。他不如我。不过好吧。我对他感到失望。艾根·阿鲁姆。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hi, how are you?
I don't think you deserve
to be here.
What about setting straight your genealogy first and then come?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，最近怎么样？
我觉得你不配待在这里。
先把你的家世理清了再来吧？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Come here.
You are the adventurer!
I love the challenge of hard trips too. Talkative old men and their adventures... You can't make me stop adventuring...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
过来。
你就是那个冒险者！
我也喜欢充满挑战的旅程。爱唠叨的老头和他的冒险故事... 你无法阻止我继续冒险...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
My name is Poe.
I am the prince of the Richard family. Remember me, and be my supporter...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我的名字是坡。
我是理查德家族的王子。记住我，并成为我的支持者...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Above all, I want to
test your ability as an adventurer. The ability test is not so serious. I just want to know how accurate your intuition is... That's all.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
首先，我想测试一下你作为冒险者的能力。能力测试并不严肃。我只是想知道你的直觉有多准确... 仅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
I don't want to talk with
a person of low intuition.
Let me explain briefly,
and test your own intuition.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我不想和直觉迟钝的人交谈。
让我简单解释一下，然后测试一下你自己的直觉。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My card has numbers from 1 to 13. You give me an answer about the card number I pick, whether it's a lesser or higher number.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我的牌上有1到13的数字。你告诉我我抽到的牌是比某个数大还是小。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ah, of course, 7 is the middle number. 7 means no success or no failure. The goal of this game is to give the right answer 2 times in a row. Let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
啊，当然，7是中间数。7代表不输也不赢。这个游戏的目的是连续猜对2次。让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Yes, now choose one
from higher and lower.
Just one.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
是的，现在从“大”和“小”中选一个。
只选一个。

scripts.text: Higher
scripts.translation: 大

scripts.text: Lower
scripts.translation: 小

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Hmm... higher?...
I now pick a card!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
嗯... 大？...
我现在抽一张牌！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
It is...{0}!!

[Poe]
Whooah, you gave the right answer!
You won 2 times in a row right?...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
哇，你猜对了！
你连续猜对了2次？...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Whooah, you gave the right answer!
But you just gave the correct answer 1 time, as of yet.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
哇，你猜对了！
但到目前为止，你只猜对了1次。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
This game is a draw.
Do better next time.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
这局算平局。
下次加油。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Wrong...

scripts.translation:
[坡]
错了...

scripts.translation:
[坡]
很好，向这样直觉敏锐且喜欢把所有牌都翻出来的人透露我的想法是理所当然的。

scripts.text:
[Poe]

scripts.translation:
[坡]
用明牌了解你，我已经很清楚了，但这次让我亮出我的王牌吧！
你想问什么都可以问我。

scripts.text:

So... What do you want to know?!
scripts.translation:

那么...你想问什么？！
