scripts.translation: 你对国家的看法...

scripts.text: Hobbies and interests...
scripts.translation: 兴趣爱好...

scripts.text: I will come by later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My background...
Past stories.
I don't give it importance at all, so I can't remember it clearly...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我的身世...
过去的经历。
我完全不在意那些，所以记不太清了...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Can I just say I am a survivor from many matches and battles. That is quite fit for me. Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我只能说，我是许多场牌局和战斗中的幸存者。这很适合我。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
I've had to cope with many accidents and challenges... from which I have survived, and have been pursuing new things. Life means...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我经历过许多意外和挑战...我都活了下来，并且一直在追求新事物。生命的意义就是...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Never let yourself down with given cards, and aim at deadly strokes!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
永远不要对自己手中的牌失望，瞄准致命的打击！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Hey it's cool, huh?
We have same tastes, haven't we?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
嘿，很酷吧？
我们的品味一样，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My opinion is a nation should provide the minimum guard for people, to guarantee respective freedom..
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我认为，国家应该为人们提供最低限度的保护，以保障各自的自由。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Men should challenge the stuff that they can be passionate about, so the free action of people should not be obstructed by their nation.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
人们应该去挑战自己热爱的事情，所以个人的自由行动不应被国家所阻碍。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If I were King, all the restrictions would be removed and liberal life would be allowed to everyone in an invulnerable range.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果我是国王，我会废除所有限制，让每个人都能在安全的范围内享受自由的生活。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Coming to think of my family, my people are so conservative and not flexible.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
说到我的家人，他们太保守了，一点也不灵活。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
They keep saying to not do this and that, that is dangerous and this is natural... The nagging has been endless all throughout my life...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
他们总是说这个不行那个不行，那个危险这个自然...这种唠叨从我出生起就没停过...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ah, those last words
are off-the-record.
I don't want to be bothered by my family.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
啊，最后几句话是私下说的。
我不想被家人找麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Experiencing anything new!
I don't care what it is!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
体验任何新事物！
我不在乎那是什么！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If our time is the exploring age, I possibly am the captain of an exploring group! Unexplored, pathfinding, investigating... Those are my middle names. How about you??
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果我们的时代是探索时代，那我可能就是探索队的船长！未探索、开路、调查...这些就是我的别名。你呢？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
But many say, about my character, that I am addicted to gambling. I am just full of a challenging spirit and I like raking in money! I am a free-spirited normal man.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
但很多人说，关于我的性格，我沉迷于赌博。我只是充满挑战精神，喜欢赢钱！我是个自由奔放的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Alright,
let's meet next at some more exciting and dangerous spot.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
好了，下次我们在更刺激、更危险的地方见面吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Appraiser.
Have you met the little girl in Aldebaran?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
评估员。
你见过艾尔帕兰那个小女孩吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I saw her for you.
scripts.translation: 是的，我替您见过她了

scripts.text: No, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想见

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am glad that the girl liked it. Once I got cured, I wanted to go meet with her.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高兴她喜欢。等我痊愈后，我想去见她一面。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Anyhow, thanks for your good work. I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. This is my sense of gratitude. Don't feel so much burden and take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
总之，谢谢你的帮忙。真抱歉让你为我这些琐事操心。这是我的心意，别觉得有负担，收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Thinking about the little girl calms me. I still can't believe my eyes. My prince Ahrum who just passed away...~
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
想到那个小女孩，我就感到平静。我到现在还不敢相信自己的眼睛。我的王子阿鲁姆刚刚才去世...~

scripts.text:
[Peter]
As you said.
I've heard that her life is like a flower when I lost it.
I will go see her on my own.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
正如你所说。
听说她的生命就像一朵花，在我失去它的时候绽放。
我会亲自去见她的。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. Please take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
真抱歉让你为我这些琐事操心。请收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Never mind.
I still can't believe my eyes. My prince Ahrum who just passed away...~~
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
算了。
我到现在还不敢相信自己的眼睛。我的王子阿鲁姆刚刚才去世...~~

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Child... What the heck happened to you?...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
孩子...你到底怎么了？...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I really appreciate it.
You are so kind.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
非常感谢。
你真好。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am glad that the girl liked it. Once I got cured, I wanted to go meet with her.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高兴她喜欢。等我痊愈后，我想去见她一面。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Anyhow, thanks for your good work. I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. This is my sense of gratitude. Don't feel so much burden and take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
总之，谢谢你的帮忙。真抱歉让你为我这些琐事操心。这是我的心意，别觉得有负担，收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Do you have any more
business, appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
评估员，你还有其他事吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
I think you are not allowed
to be here.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我想你不该来这里。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hello,
I am Peter, from the family of Heine. I am glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，我是海尔内家族的彼得。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Now, where shall we start?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
那么，我们从哪里开始呢？

scripts.text: Your background story...
scripts.translation: 你的身世背景...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你对国家的看法...

scripts.text: Hobbies and interests...
scripts.translation: 兴趣爱好...

scripts.text: I will come by later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Peter]
My family was not that influential. My childhood was not that abundant; I had to seek jobs and make money from part-time jobs.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我的家族并没有那么显赫。我的童年也不算富裕，我不得不四处找工作，靠兼职赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
But it helped me to check people's lives; the full particulars. That's my good side.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
但这让我有机会观察人们的生活，了解其中的细节。这是我的优点。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Was it enough for your question?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
这足以回答你的问题了吗？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I guess the important thing is if people fulfill themselves in their field, then only supplements of support is needed from the nation's side.
What I want to say, in short, is the nation does not reign. People need to keep peace with people.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我想，重要的是人们在自己的领域里实现自我，国家只需要提供必要的支持。
简而言之，国家并不统治一切。人们需要彼此和睦相处。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Accordingly, I will take benefits away from the difference of classes. It is not an equality issue, but for the ascension of national power.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
因此，我会取消因阶级差异而产生的特权。这并非出于平等的考量，而是为了提升国力。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I only like reading books as a hobby. I think men should go forward; they need to have a striving attitude.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我唯一的爱好就是读书。我认为男人应该向前看，需要有一种进取的态度。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Ah, is that it?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
啊，是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Then I have a favor to ask of you... Can you listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
那么，我有一个请求...你能听听我的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Originally, I didn't like growing a beard... but I had one opportunity to change... My thoughts recently are that someone has offered me the chance.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
原本，我并不喜欢留胡子...但有一次机会改变了我的看法...最近我觉得，是有人给了我这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
It is because of an unknown girl's letter...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
是因为一位陌生女孩的信...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
What she told me in the letter was that my image was too sharp, and if I grew my beard, the contour of my face would be quite hidden; and it would look far better.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
她在信里告诉我，我的形象太尖锐了，如果留了胡子，脸部的轮廓就会柔和很多，看起来会好看得多。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I want to repay her.
Because her words helped me much. Nothing special, but maybe a small bunch of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我想报答她。
因为她的话帮了我很多。没什么特别的，也许就是一小束花吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Would you take these flowers and give thanks to that girl somewhere in Al de Baran?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
你能把这些花带到艾尔帕兰，替我感谢那位女孩吗？

scripts.text: Okay, no problem.
scripts.translation: 没问题，交给我吧

scripts.text: Please ask it of another.
scripts.translation: 请找别人吧

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Yeah, thank you very much.
Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
好的，非常感谢。
请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I understand you...
I know you have your
own business.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我理解你...
我知道你有自己的事情要忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Wooah, Uncle Peter sent these flowers
for me?
Hmmm~ They smell really good.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哇，彼得叔叔送的花是给我的吗？
嗯~ 闻起来真香。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hehe~ You must be a friend of Peter's.
When you have a chance to meet him
later, please give my regards to uncle Peter.
Tell him that I loved the flowers so so much...
Okay, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
呵呵~ 你一定是彼得的朋友吧。
下次见到他时，请帮我向彼得叔叔问好。
告诉他我很喜欢这些花...非常非常喜欢...
好了，下次见。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I will go home early and
Put these flowers in a vase.
Lalala~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我要早点回家，把这些花插进花瓶里。
啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey you, have you heard the story of Daddy-Long-Legs? ... ...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，你听过长腿叔叔的故事吗？... ...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey you, have you heard the story of Daddy-Long-Legs? ... ...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，你听过长腿叔叔的故事吗？... ...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
How is Ernst ...?
He is so serious about everything. He doesn't make trouble or have outbursts... He can be kind of weird.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特怎么样...？
他对一切都那么认真。他不惹麻烦，也不发脾气...他有点奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
We were close friends. Unlike me, he is kind and compassionate; a distinct official of public affairs. When he has to be strict, he turns strict with everyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我们是亲密的朋友。不像我，他善良且富有同情心；是一位出色的公职人员。当他需要严格时，他对所有人都很严格。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am Eigen Ahrum,
I will be the light of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我是艾根·阿鲁姆，我将成为卢恩·米德加兹的光。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Whoever be the king, let's make Rune-Midgarts... the best country in the world, by helping each other.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
无论谁成为国王，让我们互相帮助，把卢恩·米德加兹...建设成世界上最好的国家。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We can make it.
No, we shall make it. For Brother and I together, we shall make it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我们能做到的。
不，我们一定能做到。我和哥哥一起，一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But... If I am to reign, or help you; and if I am corrupted... you kill me... by your hand.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
但是...如果我掌权，或者辅佐你；如果我变得腐败...你就杀了我...用你的双手。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
反之亦然，我也会杀了你，你明白吗？
所以永远不要偏离正道，也永远不要忘记你的决心。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, you think about hell. It will never happen, so... Don't talk that way.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，你想得也太可怕了。
那种事永远不会发生的，所以...别那样说。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It is an assumption.
Don't take it too seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
那只是一个假设。
别太当真。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Alright, alright. Don't
take it the wrong way.
I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
好的，好的。别误会。
我一直为了哥哥和王国在行动，以后也会一样。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ah, the appraiser has come.
How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
啊，评估员来了。
你怎么突然出现？我和恩斯特正在谈话。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
怎么了，哥哥？我们没在说坏事。
我们只是在坚定我们的决心。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You came here in good timing. We've just decided to kill the other... if one of us is corrupt.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你来得正是时候。我们刚决定，如果其中一人腐败，就杀掉对方。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
无论如何，请见证这个约定。
你不能拒绝。因为从某些方面来说，这对你的工作很有利，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。
我们的评估员必须有自己的立场和意见。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你的个性还是太弱了。我并没有强迫他做这么难的事！
谁在乎呢？我把沉默当作肯定的回答！我的提议成功了！
我们的约定也成立了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哈...哈哈...评估员，非常抱歉冒犯了你。
抱歉，但这承诺是不可能实现的。所以，别太当真...你知道的...
除非猪会飞...~

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
现在，让我回房间了。继续努力吧，评估员。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I heard that one person
from my family is coming today. But I haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我听说今天有一个人来自我的家族。但我还没找到他。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I worry about your words...
What do you want to say this time?...
Have you seen him, appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我忧心你的话...
这次你想说什么？...
你见到他了吗，评估员？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Aahh...boring, boring.
I am in real penance right now!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
啊...无聊，无聊。
我现在简直是在受罪！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You come here so often.
I know you are a faithful person, engaged in a very important issue for the kingdom, but you come here more than is necessary...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你来得太频繁了。
我知道你是个忠诚的人，正在处理王国非常重要的事务，但你来得比必要的次数多多了...

scripts.text: I have something...
scripts.translation: 我有事要说

scripts.text: Is that so? Then, see you later.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那回头见

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I saw a person from the Walter family.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我见到了沃尔特家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Oh! really?
why didn't he come to me?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
哦！真的吗？
他为什么不来找我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
-I tell Ahrum the story.-
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
-我向阿鲁姆讲述了事情经过。-

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
What! Are you 100% sure about your story? Ahhhh...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
什么！你确定你讲的是事实吗？啊...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am very sorry, but I want to be left alone. Leave me alone, right now!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
非常抱歉，我想一个人静静。现在立刻离开！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Okay, good riddance.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
好吧，走了也好。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am very sorry, but I want to be left alone. Leave me alone, right now!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
非常抱歉，我想一个人静静。现在立刻离开！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I told you that I don't want to be king, and I don't have any intention to change my mind!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我说过我不想当国王，而且我绝不改变主意！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！我不知道你为什么这么痛苦！难道你就这么软弱吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
痛苦？我吗？...啊...看起来确实很...？是啊...是的，确实如此。压力好大...呼呼...哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, Ahrum...?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，阿鲁姆...？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
...只有我能摆脱这一切吗...总之，我是个不合格的人...呼呼。不过，我已经做出了决定。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes?... Yes?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是？...是？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
拿着这个。

scripts.text: - swish. -
- Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿鲁姆随手将一把华丽短剑扔给了恩斯特。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
呃？...这是怎么回事？...沃尔特家族的华丽短剑？...为什么？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
时机真是完美。连我们的证人都在场！恩斯特，你很清楚我们之间的约定，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What? Promise? Witness?...Ahh... Re-really...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
什么？约定？证人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, really. Now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
没错，就是现在。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
胡说！你以为我会对你下杀手吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
蠢货！身为国王，就该有决断力。我根本没有机会成为国王。腐败，像这样苟活，比被你杀死更糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...不，你可以像以前一样活下去！就当什么都没发生过。你只需要回到从前的样子。哥哥，让我帮帮你。告诉我你隐藏的一切...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
这太愚蠢了！你还能说自己有王者风范吗？现在才来同情我？你应该是个有理智的人！如果不是，你就没有资格成为国王候选人！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bu...but!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...但是！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
这样来回争论毫无意义！我别无选择。如果你坚持己见，而不是像个有理智的人那样行事，那么这样的人就不配当国王。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ghh?! Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
嘎？！哥哥？！

scripts.text: (dagger thrusting sound)
scripts.translation: (短剑刺入的声音)

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bbb... Brother?... You... told me 
you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed
by me?... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？...你...你说过要杀我...你只是想让我杀你吗？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal self-defense, killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
呵呵...完全不是。我只是想杀了你...就这样...干得好，恩斯特...这是合法的正当防卫，杀死一个恶棍...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...现在还不晚！如果你去找医务兵，还能救回来！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我还能怎么活下来...或者怎么复活...我不需要活着。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother....How...how could you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...你...你怎么能这样？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
再见了，我的哥哥...成为国王，改变这个国家。你...你可以做到的...咕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥...哥哥...为什么...为什么...你的表情看起来那么满足？怎么...？哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
呵呵...你不需要知道。顺便说一句，你守住了承诺...你应该成为国王...但如果你迷失了方向，偏离了正道，我会随时从地狱爬出来杀了你...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我...我不知道！我不知道发生了什么！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你不必...你要知道的是，我做出了牺牲。为了让我的死有意义，你应当成为一位好国王。这是我的信念...就是这样...咕...！别把我的话忘了...咕咕。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Idiot... Moron...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
笨蛋...蠢货...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
啊...评估员，你知道该怎么做吗？谨言慎行。关于你看到的、听到的...你绝不能把你的经历全部告诉检查员。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特在这里杀死了那个横行霸道的恶棍...我没有机会...他展现了果断的行动，这足以让他拥有成为国王的资格...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
如果你对此事反应不当，我的死将毫无价值...咕...你明白吗？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
scripts.translation: 好的，我会遵从你的意愿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Okay, I will follow your will. Don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好的，我会遵从你的意愿。别担心...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
沉默...就是同意...这意味着...我的提议...成功了...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
现在...我可以...安息了...谢...谢你们...两个...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
那么，永远...再见...抱歉...现在没法去钓鱼了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B...bro?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B... bro, brother!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥，哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brotherrrrrrrr!!!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！！！

scripts.text:
[Prince]
You are not allowed to be here.
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你不能待在这里。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Get out of my way.
I don't want to confront you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
让开。
我不想和你冲突。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Are you the new adventurer appraiser? I am Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family. You can call me Prince Ahrum, for short, at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是新的冒险者评估员吗？我是沃尔特家族的艾根·阿鲁姆。你可以叫我阿鲁姆王子，这样比较方便。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I hope you ask me short and simple questions. Long questions don't always mean special and good answers.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我希望你问我简短明了的问题。长问题并不总是意味着特别或好的答案。

scripts.text: -What shall I ask...-
scripts.translation: -我该问什么...-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd like to ask about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想问问关于...

scripts.text: Your background story...
scripts.translation: 你的身世背景...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你对国家的看法...

scripts.text: Your hobbies or interests...
scripts.translation: 你的兴趣爱好...

scripts.text: Never mind, I'll come by later.
scripts.translation: 算了，我改天再来

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You aren't just trying to dissolve your curiosity about the king's family, are you?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你该不会只是想满足对王室的好奇心吧？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
From my childhood, I liked to experience many things and learn them. As a result, I should bear interference from my family. To them, I was not a decent noble family member.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
从小我就喜欢体验各种事物并从中学习。结果就是，我不得不忍受家族的干涉。在他们眼里，我并不是一个得体的贵族。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But I am not sensitive to that, and I think a good king should neglect those trifles.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
但我对此并不敏感，我认为一位优秀的国王应该忽略这些琐事。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Others can say that my behavior makes them embarrased, but if something ends well, they are all satisfied in the end. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
别人可能会说我的行为让他们感到尴尬，但如果事情最终圆满，他们终究会满意的。我这样想错了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Although I've skipped some lessons in life, I can back up missing lessons easily. Who cares who can swear to me as King! This is how I am.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
虽然我在生活中跳过了一些课程，但我能轻松补上缺失的部分。谁在乎谁能向我宣誓效忠为王呢！我就是这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern nags me a lot
about this, but I don't make an issue in any case. Such a fastidious jerk.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特经常为此唠叨我，但我无论如何都不会在意。真是个挑剔的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Like I said, I've been growing up with his scolds. I feel his words were harsher than others who shut their mouth after I accomplish something.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
就像我说的，我从小就是在他的斥责中长大的。我觉得他的话比那些在我做成事后就闭嘴的人更严厉。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
He always says that results cannot be everything that matter.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
他总是说，结果不能代表一切。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Before everything else, it is luck and glory for me, that I could be born in Walter, a distinguished noble family.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
首先，对我来说，最大的幸运和荣耀就是出生在沃尔特这个显赫的贵族家庭。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Of course, my abilities
are underestimated because of my background. In other respects, I feel sad about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
当然，因为我的出身，我的能力被低估了。在其他方面，我对此感到难过。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the coming age, people will talk about me as Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family, not Eigen Ahrum of Walter.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
在未来，人们会谈论沃尔特家族的艾根·阿鲁姆，而不是沃尔特的艾根·阿鲁姆。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The Walter family itself has high distinction and fame, but I will make the name shine further, and others will be proud of me.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
沃尔特家族本身享有崇高的地位和名声，但我会让这个名字更加闪耀，让其他人以我为荣。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The nation I organize
will not be harmonious
with pastel color of fairy
tales.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我要建立的国家，不会像童话那样和谐淡雅。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
For sure, losers and depressed people have their own faults, like lesser challenges for their lives.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
毫无疑问，失败者和抑郁的人自身也有过错，比如他们的人生挑战较少。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I have some belief in the benefit of unlimited competition. Frankly, I don't like this king election system from noble families.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我对无限制竞争的好处持有一些信念。坦白说，我不喜欢这种由贵族家庭进行的国王选举制度。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Although all these
status system fade away
I will be the king, with my sole capability and aptitude! Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
虽然这些地位制度终将消逝，但我将凭借我个人的能力和天赋成为国王！哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I know quite well about
other king cadidates, personally.
But I can't find one distinguished person who can lead this kingdom well.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我对其他国王候选人相当了解。但我找不到一个能很好地领导这个王国的杰出人物。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I'm not saying they aren't outstanding, but considering the current situation of Rune-Midgarts, they don't seem to be astonishing leaders.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我不是说他们不优秀，但考虑到卢恩·米德加兹的现状，他们似乎并不是令人惊叹的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
For this reason, I assure you that no candidate is fit for the position among them. If I have to pick someone who can be a match for me, I can say that one is Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
正因如此，我向你保证，他们之中没有一个人适合这个职位。如果非要选一个能与我匹敌的人，我会说是恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
He has a soft personality and thinks too long about things, but I admit many merits to him. I can say he is a fairly high-standard candidate.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
他性格温和，思考问题过于深入，但我承认他有许多优点。可以说，他是一个相当高标准的候选人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Hmm, I was too talkative.
I apologize for my redundant words, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
嗯，我话说得太多了。
抱歉说了这么多废话，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I enjoy activities.
I can't stand passive games,
like card and board games
I think those games are
quite fit for the scholar type people.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我喜欢活动。
我受不了被动的游戏，比如纸牌和棋盘游戏。
我觉得那些游戏很适合学者型的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
My brother Ern can stick to something for a long time, like books or study.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我的兄弟恩斯特能长时间专注于某件事，比如读书或学习。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Once I become king,
I won't handle documents
while sitting all day.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
一旦我成为国王，我不会整天坐着处理文件。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's very hard for me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
那对我来说非常困难。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Okay...
as you please.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
好吧...
随你便。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...brother, if you want...
...Ah, please leave here.
I don't want to see anyone.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥，如果你想...
...啊，请离开这里。
我不想见任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother Ahrum...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...阿鲁姆哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Did you meet my brother Ahrum? He is a great man. Really.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
你见过我阿鲁姆哥哥吗？他是个很棒的人。真的。

scripts.text: He tries to deal with things too tough that sometimes makes things into a problem. But even at those moments, he is willing to listen to my words; so we seldom seem to be in serious trouble.
scripts.translation: 他试图处理过于艰难的事情，有时反而会把事情搞砸。但即使在那种时候，他也愿意听我的话；所以我们很少陷入严重的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
That can only be that way, because we two have been so close to each other.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
之所以能这样，是因为我们兄弟俩一直关系很亲密。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother Ahrum has been blaming me for that, I think unnecessarily too long. But he listens to me and acts as I advise.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我觉得阿鲁姆哥哥为此责备我有些没必要，而且责备得太久了。但他听我的话，并按照我的建议行事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Isn't he a great person?
He is a trustworthy and instructive person.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
他不是一个伟大的人吗？
他是一个值得信赖且能给人启发的人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah, now I am going to have a plan with Bro Ahrum
If you don't have a important issue with me, I shall go.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊，我现在要和阿鲁姆哥哥有个计划。
如果你没有重要的事找我，我就先走了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah, I heard person from Walter came in here. Have you seen him?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊，我听说沃尔特的人来了这里。你见过他吗？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
It seems that even brother Ahrum hasn't met with him. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
看来连阿鲁姆哥哥都还没见到他。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Welcome, judge.
We meet quite open
Why don't you slow down your work?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
欢迎，评估员。
我们碰巧在这里相遇。
你何不放慢工作的节奏？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Hmm...I don't have any more words to say. Moreover, Ahrum seems to be strange these days. I worry about that. I hope it's not a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯...我没什么话要说了。而且，阿鲁姆最近似乎有些不对劲。我很担心。希望不是什么大事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ahrum is getting weird.
It's not a normal change, but a real corruption. I feel uneasy about it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
阿鲁姆变得很奇怪。
这不是普通的改变，而是真正的堕落。这让我感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
This isn't happening.
I believe Ahrum will be restored as he was. However, I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
这不可能发生。
我相信阿鲁姆会恢复原样。但我心里很不好受。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah...
Brother Ahrum...
Eigen Ahrum...yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊...
阿鲁姆哥哥...
艾根·阿鲁姆...是的，大人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Please leave here. I don't want to see anyone.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
请离开这里。我不想见任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Welcome, appraiser.
Thank you for your hard work. It's hard to judge others, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
欢迎，评估员。
感谢您的辛勤工作。评判他人是很困难的事，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
You are not a adventurer judge
I think you shouldn't be here.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你不是冒险者评估员。
我觉得你不应该在这里。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hi
you are the judege.
I am Ernst, prince of Geoborg.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，你是评估员。
我是恩斯特，吉尔伯格的王子。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I think it's hard work that judges people's talents. I will do my best to help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我认为评判他人的才能是一项艰巨的工作。我会尽力协助您。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Well, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He seems to have a polite personality as a candidate for King)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（作为国王候选人，他似乎是个彬彬有礼的人）

scripts.text: -Well, what questions.-
scripts.translation: -那么，问些什么呢？-

scripts.text: backgroud first.
scripts.translation: 先问问背景

scripts.text: I want to know your spirit of nationalism.
scripts.translation: 我想了解你的治国理念

scripts.text: Your habbit and tastes.
scripts.translation: 你的习惯和喜好

scripts.text: I will be back.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Since I was young, I have grown up with a royal education. I haven't quarreled with others seriously, but I was not very polite either.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我从小接受王室教育。虽然我没有和别人发生过严重的争吵，但我也并不十分礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
People thought that I was timid, but that's because I didn't want to be shun from others.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
人们觉得我胆小，其实是因为我不想被他人疏远。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Of course, we got an exception... Eigen.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
当然，我们也有例外...艾根。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eigen Ahrum can be the exception. He is not polite, but he makes sense from others with exact confirmation.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
艾根·阿鲁姆是个例外。他虽然不讲究礼节，却总能用确凿的结果让人信服。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I think that is a great ability, and I should learn it. But, it is not only about results, but also a courtesy matter. We should keep something that we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我认为这是一种很棒的能力，我也应该学习。但这不仅仅是结果的问题，更是礼仪的问题。有些规矩我们必须遵守。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
For me, the process was more important than the result. Now, I take them as equal virtue. I didn't take results significantly. Ahrum taught me, who used to consider the result as nothing.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
对我来说，过程比结果更重要。现在，我将两者视为同等的美德。我以前并不看重结果，是阿鲁姆教会了我这一点。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
The spirit of nationalism when I become King?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我成为国王后的治国理念？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
You might believe the power of a king is unlimited, but as one man, it has a limitation.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
你可能认为国王的权力是无限的，但作为一个人，它是有局限的。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Both normal public and prominent people take charge of the society that gathers that wisdom is easier than doing things on your own.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
无论是普通百姓还是显贵，汇聚众人的智慧来治理社会，比独自行事要容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ahrum will help me to supplement any shortcomings. Not only Ahrum, but all ministers and cabinet members; and the public is my master.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
阿鲁姆会帮我弥补不足。不仅是阿鲁姆，还有所有大臣和内阁成员；而公众才是我的主人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
It is my fortune that I got many masters beside Ahrum. It is also good for my country.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
除了阿鲁姆之外，我还有很多“主人”，这是我的幸运。这对我的国家也是好事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
II don't have special habits. I am just willing to learn and read books.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我没有特别的习惯。我只是喜欢学习和读书。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
And I also love to talk with Ahrum. Ahrum is clever enough to generate new ideas that I can follow.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我也喜欢和阿鲁姆聊天。阿鲁姆很聪明，总能产生让我能跟上的新想法。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Well, to tell the truth, going fishing with Ahrum is better. Although, we are too busy to go fishing because of all these kingdom issues.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯，说实话，和阿鲁姆去钓鱼更好。不过，因为王国事务繁忙，我们太忙了，没时间去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We promised to go fishing after the taking of the throne... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我们约定在登基后去钓鱼...让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Hmm...is that enough?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯...这样够了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes, then, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是的，那么，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Aged Noble]
You don't have to worry.
Once my Eigen Ahrum is chosen to be king, the Richard family will be a second magnate.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的贵族]
你不必担心。
一旦我的艾根·阿鲁姆被选为国王，理查德家族将成为第二大家族。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Hehe, Ahrum is the most favorable and influential candidate already. You would be so amazing were you to fulfill this.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
嘿嘿，阿鲁姆目前是最受欢迎且有影响力的候选人。如果你能促成此事，那就太棒了。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Although Ahrum is a strong candidate, the prince of Gaebolg has a high reputation for his virtues too. For sure, it is better to confirm things.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
虽然阿鲁姆是强有力的候选人，但吉尔伯格的王子也因美德而享有盛誉。当然，最好还是确认一下。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
So, are you on the project of Prince Ernst's poisoning?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
那么，你是参与了对恩斯特王子下毒的计划吗？

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Of course. Even an autopsy will not find it. ... You don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
当然。即使是尸检也查不出来...你不必担心。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Ahrum will be elected, once the termination of prince Ernst happens, and then...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
一旦恩斯特王子“去世”，阿鲁姆就会被选为国王，然后...

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
both family will lead this country, huhuhu.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
两个家族将共同领导这个国家，呼呼呼。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
You must know what Walter and Gaebolg did. Both families stayed on top of the country.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
你应该知道沃尔特和吉尔伯格做过什么。这两个家族一直凌驾于国家之上。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
The weakest one of the seven families, Gaebolg Family, took power by uniting with Schmidt and Walter.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
七大家族中最弱的吉尔伯格家族，通过与施密特和沃尔特结盟夺取了权力。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Yes, that's why the union of Walter and Gaebolg is perfect. Moreover, Ahrum and Ernst... It's obviously the second coming of Schmidt and Heinrich.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
是的，这就是为什么沃尔特和吉尔伯格的联盟是完美的。而且，阿鲁姆和恩斯特...这显然是施密特和海因里希的转世。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
That's why the Walter family and the Gaebolg Family can't exist together. Their co-existence will bring destruction as it has done in the past.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
所以沃尔特家族和吉尔伯格家族无法共存。它们的共存将带来毁灭，就像过去发生过的那样。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Thanks for that. It's good to go. All the people who know of the past will deny to be in league with Ahrum or Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
谢谢。很好。所有知道过去的人都会否认与阿鲁姆或恩斯特有牵连。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Anyway, we got a little bit more time. Keep the secret thoroughly; not to tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
总之，我们多了一点时间。彻底保守秘密；不要告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Yes. For the glory of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
是的。为了卢恩·米德加兹的荣耀。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
All the glory for Rune-Midgarts...
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
所有的荣耀都归于卢恩·米德加兹...
嗯？

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Quiet... Someone comes.
Ok... take care.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的男子]
安静...有人来了。
好的...保重。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Never mind...
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
别在意...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Walter is the name of Ahrum.
Richard is the name of Poe.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（沃尔特是阿鲁姆的家族。
理查德是坡的家族。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Is this the conspiracy of two families? What the hell..)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(这是两个家族的阴谋吗？该死...)

scripts.text:
[Young Noble Walter]
Step aside.
How dare you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[年轻贵族 沃尔特]
让开。
你竟敢和他说话。

scripts.text:
[Aged Noble Richard]
Hmm-hmm.
What an indecorous person!
scripts.translation:
[年迈贵族 理查德]
嗯哼。
多么无礼的人！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I told you that I don't want to be king, and I don't have any intention to change my mind!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我说过我不想当国王，而且我绝不改变主意！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！我不知道你为什么这么痛苦！难道你就这么软弱吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
痛苦？我吗？...啊...看起来确实很...？是啊...是的，确实如此。压力好大...呼呼...哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, Ahrum...?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，阿鲁姆...？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
...只有我能摆脱这一切吗...总之，我是个不合格的人...呼呼。不过，我已经做出了决定。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes?... Yes?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是？...是？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
拿着这个。

scripts.text: - swish. -
- Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿鲁姆随手将一把华丽短剑扔给了恩斯特。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
呃？...这是怎么回事？...沃尔特家族的华丽短剑？...为什么？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
时机真是完美。连我们的证人都在场！恩斯特，你很清楚我们之间的约定，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What? Promise? Witness?...Ahh... Re-really...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
什么？约定？证人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, really. Now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
没错，就是现在。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
胡说！你以为我会对你下杀手吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
蠢货！身为国王，就该有决断力。我根本没有机会成为国王。腐败，像这样苟活，比被你杀死更糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...不，你可以像以前一样活下去！就当什么都没发生过。你只需要回到从前的样子。哥哥，让我帮帮你。告诉我你隐藏的一切...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
这太愚蠢了！你还能说自己有王者风范吗？现在才来同情我？你应该是个有理智的人！如果不是，你就没有资格成为国王候选人！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bu...but!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...但是！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
这样来回争论毫无意义！我别无选择。如果你坚持己见，而不是像个有理智的人那样行事，那么这样的人就不配当国王。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ghh?! Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
嘎？！哥哥？！

scripts.text: (dagger thrusting sound)
scripts.translation: (短剑刺入的声音)

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Whoever be the king,
let's make Rune-Midgarts...
the best country in the world, by helping each other.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
无论谁成为国王，让我们帮助彼此，使卢恩·米德加兹成为世界上最好的国家。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We can make it.
No, we shall make it. For Brother and I together, we shall make it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我们能做到的。
不，我们一定能做到。我和哥哥一起，一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But... If I am to reign, or help you; and if I am corrupted... you kill me... by your hand.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
但是...如果我掌权，或者辅佐你；如果我变得腐败...你就杀了我...用你的双手。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
反之亦然，我也会杀了你，你明白吗？
所以永远不要偏离正道，也永远不要忘记你的决心。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, you think about hell.
It will never happen, so...
Don't talk that way.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，你想得也太可怕了。
那种事永远不会发生的，所以...别那样说。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It is an assumption.
Don't take it too seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
那只是一个假设。
别太当真。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Alright, alright. Don't
take it the wrong way.
I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
好的，好的。别误会。
我一直为了哥哥和王国在行动，以后也会一样。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ah, the appraiser has come.
How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
啊，评估员来了。
你怎么突然出现？我和恩斯特正在谈话。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
怎么了，哥哥？我们没在说坏事。
我们只是在坚定我们的决心。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You came here in good timing.
We've just decided to kill
the other... if one of us is
corrupt.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你来得正是时候。
我们刚刚决定，如果我们中有一个腐败，就杀掉另一个。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
无论如何，请见证这个约定。
你不能拒绝。因为从某些方面来说，这对你的工作很有利，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。
我们的评估员必须有自己的立场和意见。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你的个性还是太弱了。我并没有强迫他做这么难的事！
谁在乎呢？我把沉默当作肯定的回答！我的提议成功了！
我们的约定也成立了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哈...哈哈...评估员，非常抱歉冒犯了你。
抱歉，但这承诺是不可能实现的。所以，别太当真...你知道的...
除非猪会飞...~

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
现在，让我回房间了。继续努力吧，评估员。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bbb... Brother?... You... told me you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed by me??... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？...你...你说过要杀我...你只是想让我杀你吗？？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal, self-defense; killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
呵呵...完全不是。我只是想杀了你...就这样...干得好，恩斯特...这是合法的正当防卫，杀死一个恶棍...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...现在还不晚！如果你去找医务兵，还能救回来！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我还能怎么活下来...或者怎么复活...我不需要活着。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother....How...how could you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...你...你怎么能这样？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
再见了，我的哥哥...成为国王，改变这个国家。你...你可以做到的...咕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥...哥哥...为什么...为什么...你的表情看起来那么满足？怎么...？哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
呵呵...你不需要知道。顺便说一句，你守住了承诺...你应该成为国王...但如果你迷失了方向，偏离了正道，我会随时从地狱爬出来杀了你...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我...我不知道！我不知道发生了什么！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你不必...你要知道的是，我做出了牺牲。为了让我的死有意义，你应当成为一位好国王。这是我的信念...就是这样...咕...！别把我的话忘了...咕咕。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Idiot... Moron...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
笨蛋...蠢货...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
啊...评估员，你知道该怎么做吗？谨言慎行。关于你看到的、听到的...你绝不能把你的经历全部告诉检查员。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
恩斯特在这里杀死了那个横行霸道的恶棍...我没有机会...他展现了果断的行动，这足以让他拥有成为国王的资格...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
如果你对此事反应不当，我的死将毫无价值...咕...你明白吗？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
scripts.translation: 好的，我会遵从你的意愿...

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好的，我会遵从你的意愿。别担心...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
沉默...就是同意...这意味着...我的提议...成功了...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
现在...我可以...安息了...谢...谢你们...两个...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
那么，永远...再见...抱歉...现在没法去钓鱼了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B...bro?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B... bro, brother!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥，哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brotherrrrrrrr!!!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！！！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Moron. You'll never be a king. All throughout your life... Don't you know it? Such a junk addict!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
蠢货。你永远成不了国王。你这一生...难道你不知道吗？真是个毒瘾缠身的废物！！

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...I am not trying to be, but swear words don't make me feel very good. What's wrong with you all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
...我并没有那个意思，但被骂脏话让我很不舒服。你们怎么突然都这样？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am just fed up with you. Even a jerk like you is a candidate for king? I feel sick and nauseated about this king succession.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我只是受够你了。连你这种混蛋都有资格竞选国王？想到王位继承这件事我就恶心反胃。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Yeah, it's not that wrong. But I am the representative of the Nerious family. I cannot stand for your insults.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
嗯，你说得也没错。但我代表的是内里乌斯家族。我不能容忍你的侮辱。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Is your family aware of your crazy actions? You are ruining your name, and of your family.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
你的家人知道你这些疯狂的举动吗？你正在毁掉自己的名声，还有你家族的名声。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...! Yes... I give a crap. No... My existence too! Kukuku...hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
...！是的...我在乎。不...连我的存在也在乎！库库库...哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, you and I are both disqualified! Hahahaha!! The freaking addict reveals the truth! Yes, hahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
是的，你和我都不合格！哈哈哈哈！！该死的瘾君子终于说出真相了！是的，哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Erich]
... Crazy jerk. Beat it. I don't want to talk with you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
...疯了的混蛋。滚开。我不想再和你说话了。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, I am going now. Family shame?!! Hahahaha... What is a family!! Kkkkkk!! Very interesting!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
是的，我现在就走。家族耻辱？！！哈哈哈哈...什么是家族！！库库库库！！真有趣！

scripts.text: -Ahrum, seems to be out of his mind, as he approaches the door-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆似乎已经疯了，他走向门口-

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...Nuts.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
...疯了。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
What did you say? Ahrum?
Hey! What did you just say to me? Ahrum?!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
你说什么？阿鲁姆？
嘿！你刚才对我说什么？阿鲁姆？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I can say it a zillion times! Urugen, you are not beautiful at all! Not even a bit! In fact, your look is very ugly and obscene!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我可以重复一百万遍！乌鲁根，你一点都不漂亮！一点都不！事实上，你的长相非常丑陋且下流！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
That's very rude! How could a dirty germ like you talk like that to me!
you like germ can talk like that
to me!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
太无礼了！像你这种肮脏的细菌怎么敢那样对我说话！
像你这种细菌怎么敢那样对我说话！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Dirty? Yes, I am. I am dirty. But it is not a problem of mine. Everything is dirty! I cannot stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
肮脏？是的，我很肮脏。我很脏。但这不是我的问题。一切都是肮脏的！我再也受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Hm! I can agree with your words, the world is obscene, but you cannot bring me down to that level! I cannot forgive your words! Never, ever!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
哼！我同意你的话，世界很下流，但你不能把我拉到那个层次！我绝不能原谅你的话！永远，永远都不能！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
What if you can't forgive me? What shall you do? That's good. Are you gonna kill me? Will you kill me? Kill me? Haha? You are being called beautiful only when calling yourself!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
如果你不能原谅我怎么办？你要做什么？很好。你要杀我吗？你会杀我吗？杀我？哈哈？只有你自己叫自己漂亮的时候，你才显得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Akk! I cannot stand this! Such low behavior and words ...? You are no prince. I don't want to face you anymore! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
啊！我受不了了！如此低俗的行为和言语...？你根本不是王子。我不想再面对你了！滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't have enough quality. You don't have belief to eliminate evil. By will, you are rubbish. I don't want to be with rubbish either! Stay in your world forever and never come out of it!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你没有足够的素质。你没有铲除邪恶的信念。论意志，你就是个废物。我也不想和废物待在一起！永远待在你自己的世界里，永远别出来！

scripts.text: -Ahrum strides out of the room, grumbling...-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆一边嘟囔着一边走出房间-

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...You are so low. I misjudged you. You are not of the few that have an artistic view. I totally saw you the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁根]
...你真是低俗。我看错你了。你并不是少数拥有艺术眼光的人。我完全看走眼了。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Military maniac! Jerk! Do you think power can solve everything? In all situations, do you think people can live peacefully?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
军事狂！混蛋！你以为权力能解决一切吗？在任何情况下，你以为人们都能和平共处吗？！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You are fully violent now.
By your theory, you are also not eligible for the king's quality!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你现在完全被暴力支配了。
照你的理论，你也不具备国王的素质！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, you talk well. Bah!
I don't have quality!!
But you are worse than me! King candidate?? You are just a war monger!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
是啊，你话说得挺漂亮。哼！
我没有素质！！
但你比我更糟糕！国王候选人？？你只是个战争狂人！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You have come here to offend me? Do you think you can beat me, Eigen Ahrum?!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你来这里就是为了侮辱我吗？你以为你能打败我，艾根·阿鲁姆？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Fight? That's so rubbish. I don't care for it. I just came here to shoot what I want to say to you. I don't even feel like fighting with you. I am leaving!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
打架？那太无聊了。我不在乎。我只是来这里说我想对你说的话。我甚至不想和你打。我要走了！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hold on, coward! Are you fleeing now?! Such a coward! Let's finish our battle!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
站住，胆小鬼！你现在要逃跑吗？！真是胆小鬼！让我们结束这场战斗吧！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Coward.. that's a very nice word. Yes, I am. I am leaving. Ta-tah! You are worse than a bad coward...like me! Bye-bye war monger!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
胆小鬼...这个词真不错。没错，我就是。我要走了。拜拜！你比我这种差劲的胆小鬼...还要糟糕！再见，战争狂人！

scripts.text: -Ahrum grins with a vague feeling towards an irritated Helmut, and leaves the room.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆意味不明地朝恼怒的赫尔穆特咧嘴一笑，离开了房间。-

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
That is... such a villain!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
真是...太卑鄙了！！！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You always care about gambling. But, why don't you care about your surrondings first, eh? Young master of Richard?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你总是关心赌博。但是，为什么你不先关心一下你的周围环境呢？理查德的少爷？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Why are you teasing me, now? At least I feel I have dice with higher numbers than you... You don't think so?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
你现在为什么取笑我？至少我觉得我的骰子点数比你高...你不这么认为吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Posh! You keep talking about dice. Listen. You can feel that I roll lower numbers of dice than you... But you have already failed before the roll of your dice! Do you know that?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
哼！你一直谈论骰子。听着。你能感觉到我掷出的骰子点数比你低...但你在掷骰子之前就已经失败了！你知道吗？！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
What are you talking about? I can't get you. I've lost to whom? I don't know why you are talking like that.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
你在说什么？我听不懂。我输给了谁？我不知道你为什么那样说。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You can't know it! So what?! If you know, what can you do? You have too much pride over everything. Do you think you can foster a deeply rotten tree, to become a healthy tree?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你不知道！那又怎样？！如果你知道，你能做什么？你对一切都太骄傲了。你以为你能培育一棵深深腐朽的树，让它变成一棵健康的树吗？！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If you want to say something, you have to say it clearly. Are you announcing a loss and defeat? Is my luck so dreadful, Eigen Ahrum?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果你想说什么，你就得说清楚。你是在宣布失败和战败吗？我的运气这么糟糕，艾根·阿鲁姆？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, I announce my defeat. But it is not to you. You are a loser like me. Before getting into important business, you are ruined by an environmental element.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
是的，我宣布我的失败。但不是对你。你和我一样是个失败者。在从事重要事务之前，你已经被环境因素毁了。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
...What the hell are you talking about? Environment? I totally don't get you. It is never clear.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
...你到底在说什么？环境？我完全听不懂。你说的话总是让人摸不着头脑。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You'd better not understand it. If you know this, you will lose your health. Don't care for it... for the rest of your life!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
你最好别明白。如果你知道这一点，你会失去健康。别在意它...在你余生里！！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ho- hold! Look, Ahrum!
Hold on! Eigen Ahrum! Hey!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
等-等一下！看，阿鲁姆！
站住！艾根·阿鲁姆！嘿！

scripts.text:
-Ahrum totally neglects the
voice calling him and leaves the room, with a lonely countenance.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆完全无视了呼唤他的声音，带着孤独的神情离开了房间。-

scripts.text:
[Poe]
What... What. It's not fun.
I totally couldn't get him.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
什...什么。这不好玩。
我完全没搞懂他。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Peter, what will you do if your work doesn't mean anything?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
彼得，如果你的工作毫无意义，你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
...I don't know what you are talking about, but meaningless things do not exist. I don't think you know about that.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
...我不知道你在说什么，但不存在毫无意义的事物。我想你并不了解这一点。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Buzzzz. You are wrong. There is a thing that is meaningless itself. Clearly speaking, the action becomes meaningless without knowing its meaning...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
嗡嗡。你错了。存在本身就没有意义的事物。确切地说，如果不知道其意义，行动就会变得毫无意义...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Are you trying to explain... clearly? It's getting more complicated. What exactly do you want to say? Let me get it directly.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
你是在试图...解释清楚吗？事情变得越来越复杂了。你到底想说什么？直接告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Whatever I do or do not do, I am just being manipulated by some thing. To make it worse, I hurt others as I am in that some thing only.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
...无论我做或不做，我都只是被某物操控着。更糟糕的是，因为身处在那某物之中，我伤害了他人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The worst thing is, I feel I just become timid with knowing and understanding the some thing itself..
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
最糟糕的是，随着对那某物本身的认知和理解，我感到自己变得愈发胆怯...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But it is the same with you. If you really want to express gratitude towards the girl, you should have visited her in person. You couldn't do it, could you?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
但你也是一样。如果你真的想向那个女孩表达感激，你应该亲自去拜访她。你做不到，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
...Ahrum, what's wrong with you? You are not the Ahrum I know. What's made you like this?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
...阿鲁姆，你怎么了？你不再是那个我认识的阿鲁姆了。是什么让你变成这样的？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Hmph..The some thing. Nothing. It's meaningless. Reality, that's all. It was nice talking to you. Bye-bye, and live like what you used to live like, ever after.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
哼...那某物。没什么。毫无意义。这就是现实。和你聊天很开心。再见，以后就按你以前的生活方式生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
......Eigen Ahrum. You...
-Ahrum shows a gloomy facial expression and leaves the room.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆露出阴郁的表情，离开了房间。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bro, tell me again. You just said something?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，再说一遍。你刚才说了什么？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ok. Let me tell you. This Rune-Midgarts is rubbish. You and I struggle in the dump of trash, and we are all same with it, even if it cannot be recycled.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
好吧。让我告诉你。这个卢恩·米德加兹是个垃圾场。你和我在垃圾堆里挣扎，我们和它都一样，即使它无法被回收。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, what's wrong? Are you insane?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，你怎么了？你疯了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Insane? I am fully sane....J.m...I am just fed up with this disgusting reality, my lovely brother.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
疯？我完全清醒....J.m...我只是受够了这个令人作呕的现实，我亲爱的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Reality? What reality? What did you perceive? You are not like as you are. I totally can't help you!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
现实？什么现实？你察觉到了什么？你变得不像你自己了。我完全帮不了你！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am as I usually am, Ernst. Just, reality is dirty, and I realized that I am trapped in the crap. I can't get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我和平时一样，恩斯特。只是，现实很肮脏，我意识到自己被困在垃圾里。我出不去了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Liar! You always told me that you have possibilities in your book! You always behaved proudly!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
骗子！你总是告诉我你的书里有无限可能！你总是表现得那么骄傲！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Shut up.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
闭嘴。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
It's dirty and not good. That's why we should correct it. We already know about this situation, but why do you act like this!!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
这很肮脏，也不对劲。所以我们应该纠正它。我们已经知道这种情况了，但你为什么还要这样！！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...I told you, don't make noise!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
...我告诉过你，别吵了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
No. Corruption is mutually agreed, and you brought me here, and because of your presence, I can depend on you!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不。腐败是双方同意的，是你把我带到这里的，因为你的存在，我可以依靠你！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Shut up Shut up!!!!!!!!!!!!

[Ahrum]
Meaningless actions cannot be welcomed! Being manipulated by dirt is disgusting. I was ignorant, I felt that I acted by my will, but now I realize I was manipulated!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
无意义的行为不值得欢迎！被肮脏之物操控令人作呕。我曾无知地以为自己是按自己的意志行事，但现在我意识到自己是被操控的！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
King?! What's that for?! That's nothing! Even if we make a new world, nothing is changed!! We are like in a play. A picture is someone's intention... only drawn!! Right?!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
国王？！那算什么？！那毫无意义！即使我们创造新世界，也什么都不会改变！！我们就像在演戏。画面只是某人意图...画出来的！！对吧？！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What are you talking about? I totally can't understand! Are you saying you are not in the status quo? Yes? What the heck are you talking about!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
你在说什么？我完全听不懂！你是说你不处于现状？是吗？你到底在说什么鬼话！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Shut up! Without knowing anything, you don't know when you can be killed. You don't get me yet.... ah...! You need to not know this!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
闭嘴！什么都不知道，你就不知道什么时候会被杀。你还不懂我....啊...！你不该知道这些！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Br...Brother, will you keep insisting on this? Our relationship is this short?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥，你还要坚持这种说法吗？我们的情谊就这么浅吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Shut up! If you are not contented, you can kill me as we promised! You... me... me...!! I don't wanna talk about it any more, I am going back to my room!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
闭嘴！如果你不满意，就按我们的约定杀了我吧！你...我...我...！！我不想再谈这个了，我要回房间了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah. Hold on a moment Brother! Ahrum!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊。等一下，哥哥！阿鲁姆！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I... don't know! King... you!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我...不知道！国王...你！

scripts.text:
-Ahrum blushes
and leaves the room. He seems to be utterly fatigued.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆脸红着离开了房间。他看起来精疲力竭。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ahrum... Ahrum...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
阿鲁姆...阿鲁姆...

scripts.text:
-You can hear Ahrum's voice
before going into his room
It's coming from inside.-
scripts.translation:
-在你进入他的房间之前，你能听到阿鲁姆的声音。
声音是从里面传出来的。-

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I cannot have that qualification. I was raised in such a dirty place. I was so ignorant!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我不具备那种资格。我是在那样肮脏的地方长大的。我太无知了！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
What's the capacity of a king? And what is clean politics...? Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
国王的职责是什么？还有什么是清廉的政治...？啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

scripts.text:
-You can hear Ahrum's voice
before going into his room
It's coming from inside.-
scripts.translation:
-在你进入他的房间之前，你能听到阿鲁姆的声音。
声音是从里面传出来的。-

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Proud family?... Famous...
Birth?... King's family? ...What's all that about?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
显赫的家族？...著名的...
出身？...国王的家族？...那都是些什么？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
To brother Ernst, from my family. It's sin. And I am a part of the sin. As a part of the family. Family's sin. Equal to my sin.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
致兄弟恩斯特，来自我的家族。这是罪孽。而我也是罪孽的一部分。作为家族的一员。家族的罪孽。等同于我的罪孽。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I cannot... cover it anymore... Ern... I hope even you...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我再也...无法掩盖了...恩...我希望连你...也能...

scripts.text:
-You can hear Ahrum's voice
before going into his room
It's coming from inside.-
scripts.translation:
-在你进入他的房间之前，你能听到阿鲁姆的声音。
声音是从里面传出来的。-

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the end, I am just being used... I make the most of my exertions and become the lead. That's all a part of the scenario...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
到头来，我只是被利用罢了...我竭尽全力，成为领袖。那不过是剧本的一部分...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Damn it! Damn...!!
I cannot accept it. Never. Never!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
该死！该死...！！
我无法接受。绝不。绝不！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
My ancestor ^FF0000Schmidt^000000... What shall you do with this situation? No...were you just used like me... by others?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
我的祖先^FF0000施密特^000000...面对这种局面，你会怎么做？不...难道你也是像我一样...被他人利用了吗？

scripts.text:
- I could hear Ahrum's voice 
before getting into his room
It was coming from inside.-
scripts.translation:
-在你进入他的房间之前，你能听到阿鲁姆的声音。
声音是从里面传出来的。-

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
No, it's no good... No... In this phase, I will be the king. I shouldn't be the king... Ern... You should not forget the meaning of a real king.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
不，这样不行...不...在这个阶段，我将成为国王。我不应该成为国王...恩...你不应该忘记真正国王的意义。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
For the real king's appearance... I am going tonight.... to darkness for you. ...Ahhhhhhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
为了真正国王的出现...今晚我将前往...为了你，走向黑暗。...啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Guard of a strange place]
You can go to the room where princes gather, through the hidden door. For security reasons, it is totally guarded and hidden.
scripts.translation:
[奇异之地的守卫]
你可以通过隐藏的门前往王子们聚集的房间。出于安全考虑，那里被严密守卫并隐藏起来。

scripts.text:
[Guard of a strange place]
Let me open the door.
scripts.translation:
[奇异之地的守卫]
让我来开门。

scripts.text:
[Guard of a strange place]
I just came here to rest. For location information, you can ask it of others.
scripts.translation:
[奇异之地的守卫]
我只是来这里休息的。关于位置信息，你可以去问别人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Milk is all spilt.
Just forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
牛奶已经洒了。
就忘了它吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is going to have the throne instead of him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谁将取代他坐上王位？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What thoughts did he have, and how did he decide to become King in this room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他当时在想什么，又是如何决定在这个房间里成为国王的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What situation...
pulled him back to an irreparable place?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是什么样的处境...
将他推向了无法挽回的地步？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't ask him anymore, and there are no clues left. Just what's left is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我无法再问他了，也没有留下任何线索。剩下的只有...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
~~If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?~~
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁姆]
~~如果你对此事反应不当，我的死将毫无意义...咳...你明白吗？~~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Keeping silent for him.
Taking the burden that he left... all throughout my life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...为他保持沉默。
承担他留下的重担...直到我生命的尽头。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Rest in peace.
